summary: P2637 Gulf South Willis Lateral: a real, FERC-certificated (CP18-525) 19-mile 24-inch intrastate Texas lateral, 200 MMcf/d, $96.178M, in service 2020. RE-RESEARCHED 2026-09-14 by the orchestrator after the first pass wrongly reported the project absent from EIA and left 12 of 14 units unresolved. It is in fact in 27 consecutive EIA releases (Aug 2018 - Aug 2026) with identical figures, confirming Start, Capacity, Length, Diameter, Location and SegmentCost exactly; Operator filled from EIA + Boardwalk's FY2025 10-K (two publishers, high); Owner re-grounded on Boardwalk's own SEC filing. Three units remain genuinely unresolved (Construction, Pressure, FuelSource), each owed the CP18-525 docket. No existence, duplicate or classification concern.
